Exact row quoted: "2026-02-11 | MARUTI CHEMICALS | AOR - ADVANCED ORTHOMOLECULAR RESEA | LUBSOLV SODIUM STEARYL FUMARATE NF AS PER INVOICE- AHEMDABAD AIR ACC INAMD4, India | CALGARY, Canada | 29171990 | 9586980". Second export row: "2025-09-01 | MARUTI CHEMICALS | AOR ADVANCED ORTHOMOLECULAR RESEA | ... AHMEDABAD AIR CARGO, India | CALGARY, Canada | 29171990 | 3109491". Counter check: page header claims 29 shipments; the free view displayed 5 detail rows (2 outbound to Canada, 3 inbound from China/Korea) — so 29 is the platform's total, only 5 rows were actually visible.

SOLA OVERBRIDGE APPROACH, GULAB...", Ahmedabad, Gujarat) is consistent with the claimed state but is a registry/contact field, not supply evidence. Domestic supply: not public in the sources checked.
note: Export side is factually supported: two dated outbound customs records to Calgary, Canada under HS 29171990 (acyclic polycarboxylic acids/derivatives — matches declared 291719), with B/L numbers 9586980 (2026-02-11) and 3109491 (2025-09-01). Declared HS 350520 (dextrins/glues) has no supporting shipment row; the observed export code is 29171990, so the HS field should be corrected to the factual code rather than the company rejected. Caveat: the same ImportKey page mixes import and export lanes for the name 'MARUTI CHEMICALS' (inbound rows from Chongqing Lihong Fine Chemicals, MDNF, Jansonlee) and the name is not unique in Indian trade data — the outbound rows are attributed to the Ahmedabad entity, but buyer-side counterparties (AOR Canada, Protek-SVM Russia, Przedsiebiorstwo Przemyslowo-Handlowe Poland) appear as aggregated name matches, so exact legal-entity linkage is not proven. No CIN/PAN published on the sources read; left null. Revenue and export volume: null — not public. Domestic supply traces not found; do not treat as confirmed either way.
